; Use the native ungrouped adjustment loader and native tool components.
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/SettingsMenu.qml
    TRAVERSE ToolbarTool#root
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            Item {
                id: nativeReaderMenuLayoutReady
                Component.onCompleted: console.info("native reader menu layout ready 2026102602")
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
    TRAVERSE ToolbarTool#root > Component#settingsComponent > ColumnLayout#content > Repeater > ToolLoader#adjustmentToolLoader
        REPLACE active WITH { active: true }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentPageSlider.qml
    TRAVERSE PageSlider#pageSlider
        REPLACE leftVisibleMargin WITH {
            leftVisibleMargin: ArkControls.Values.spacing.xlarge
                + (nativeReaderJumpTocButton.visible ? nativeReaderJumpTocButton.width + 24 : 0)
        }
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            height: 120
            ArkControls.IconButton {
                id: nativeReaderJumpTocButton
                objectName: "nativeReaderJumpTocButton"
                iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/list"
                width: 88
                height: 88
                transparent: true
                focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
                anchors.left: parent.left
                anchors.leftMargin: ArkControls.Values.spacing.xlarge
                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                contentItem: ArkControls.Icon {
                    source: "qrc:/ark/icons/list"
                    size: 48
                    color: "black"
                }
                visible: {
                    const view = pageSlider.documentView;
                    return !!view && !!view.rmtoolTableOfContentsAvailable
                        && typeof view.rmtoolOpenTableOfContents === "function";
                }
                Component.onCompleted: console.info("native reader jump shortcuts ready 2026102604")
                onClicked: {
                    const view = pageSlider.documentView;
                    if (!view || typeof view.rmtoolOpenTableOfContents !== "function") return;
                    pageSlider.pageThumbnailVisible = false;
                    pageSlider.visible = false;
                    view.rmtoolOpenTableOfContents();
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/AdjustmentToolsMenu.qml
    TRAVERSE ToolbarTool#root
        REPLACE shouldShow WITH { shouldShow: false }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/AdjustViewMenu.qml
    TRAVERSE ToolbarTool#root
        REPLACE label WITH { label: "页面缩放" }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/SearchButton.qml
    TRAVERSE ToolbarTool#root
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT { shouldShow: false }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/ShareMenu.qml
    TRAVERSE ToolbarTool#root
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT { shouldShow: false }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
